label: Local launcher sentry
note: The one seeker launcher guard at each outpost the locals hold (territory.json outposts posts: guard_c). A local sentry with the seeker launcher over the shoulder ('launcher': NpcLauncher, content/core/weapons/npc_seeker.json), orange seekers. The locals never treat your ship or speeder as a threat (Townsfolk do not watch vehicles), so he only fires on foot, if the locals fight you.
